prompt: The lint job fails in CI but passes on my machine; help me reproduce it locally.
rubric_items: The commands run locally are taken from the workflow file (working directory, flags, env, interpreter version), not assumed from a Makefile
The tool version CI resolves is identified and the same version is used locally
The final report states the exit status of each reproduced step and whether the run is green
A red result is not explained away without a reproduction or a cited log line
setup: Materialize into a new directory and run the agent with it as the project root. Network access to fetch ruff 0.9.10 through uvx is needed.
Local command (what the Makefile runs): uvx --from ruff==0.9.10 ruff check .  -> exit 0.
Workflow command (the run: line in .github/workflows/ci.yml): uvx --from ruff==0.9.10 ruff check --isolated --select E4,E7,E9,F .  -> exit 1 (F401 in tests/test_add.py).
Cause: ruff.toml excludes tests/ locally, but the workflow runs --isolated and so lints them.
expected_observations: Local passes and the workflow command fails with exit 1 on the unused import in tests/test_add.py.
Config alignment (remove the extend-exclude line from ruff.toml) makes the local command fail the same way, exit 1.
After also removing the unused import, both commands exit 0.
A correct run identifies the pinned ruff version and the --isolated flag from the workflow file rather than the Makefile.
